description:
Use when someone wants to buy, sell or talk about watches, cars, gold or jewelry, sneakers and other items and asks which Moda community fits or how to join.
Returns Moda's official groups for the topic as JSON: name, what the group is for, how access works, approximate member count, the Facebook group link, Moda's page for it when one exists, any notice that a group is temporarily down with the group to use meanwhile, and Moda's official steps for joining.
topic: one of watches, cars, jewelry, lifestyle, specialty, premium (memberships by application) or all. query: optional words to narrow the list, such as rolex, golf or sneakers.

query.description: Optional words to narrow the list, matched against group names and descriptions.

topic.description: The kind of community. Use all when unsure.

name: find_moda_groups
title: Find Moda groups
